issues.description: Method parameter type mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents(...): the problem statement task text in problem_statement.md declares addGuestStudents(String) (textual signature), whereas the UML in problem_statement.md and the reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declare addGuestStudents(int). This mismatch (String vs int) will confuse students about the correct method signature to implement and what type to pass when adding guest students.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across artifacts. The recommended fix is to update the problem statement text to specify addGuestStudents(int) and clarify that the method accepts an integer number of new guest students to match the UML and reference implementation. If a String parameter was intentionally required, update the UML, the template TODO, and the solution implementation to use addGuestStudents(String) and document how the string should be interpreted (e.g., parsed to an int).
